purpose: Govern automatic exact compaction, semantic consolidation, relevance retrieval and memory tiering without allowing lossy summaries to erase source truth.
writePath: append event to immutable/raw provenance vault
store repeated schema/vocabulary once per segment
verify exact reconstruction SHA-256 before promoting compact representation
derive semantic capsule separately with source event hashes
use relevance/need policy to place hot, warm or cold memory
retrieve only memory that can materially alter Goal/State/Observation

tiers.T1: Exact structural Formula Memory Pack — lossless reconstructable representation.
tiers.T2: Semantic capsule — lossy working abstraction with immutable source hashes.
tiers.T3: Active working set — only currently relevant memory.

observationWindow.rule: 16 compatible memory events or memory-management decisions under one policy/profile.

automaticLaw: Every memory write is immediately hashed/classified; exact structural compaction occurs automatically at segment closure; semantic consolidation never replaces unreconstructable truth.
claimBoundary: This prototype proves exact structural compaction on simulator cognition records. It is not yet integrated into all live Pocket/Agent Lee memory stores.
